candidate.title: scMT-seq
candidate.scope: Single assigned scMT-seq row of the Illumina poster, with Hu et al. (2016; Genome Biology 17:88; PMID 27150361; DOI 10.1186/s13059-016-0950-z) used to resolve architecture-changing discrepancies. Top scM&T-seq, bottom scTrio-seq, and the right-hand chemical structure are neighboring context, not additional targets. IDs d_ preserve the row as drawn; except for the shared single-cell isolation interface, they are source-only observations of an unsupported bead-based depiction. IDs p_ provide a separate primary-supported cytosol/intact-nucleus interface and its broad library/readout blocks for the reported adult mouse DRG-neuron implementation of scMT-seq. The two routes are evidentiary representations, not demonstrated experimental alternatives, and are not simultaneous branches to run on one cell. No complete implementation equivalence or historical relationship is asserted. Smart-seq2 and RRBS are components, not additional method targets.
